items.title: 27.2.2 Proteins ke biological functions (jism mein kaam) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the biological functions of proteins with Quick Check 27.2 answered (PDF 166-167).

blocks.text: Proteins ko un ke biological aur metabolic functions (kaamon) ke lihaz se mukhtalif categories (qismon) mein baanta ja sakta hai. Kuch proteins jism ki khaas physiological activities, jaise growth (barhna), development (nashonuma), metabolism aur reproduction (nasal barhana), ko control karte hain. Inhein Hormonal Proteins kehte hain. Misal: insulin, jo hamare jism mein pancreas banata hai aur glucose ko khoon se cells ke andar jane ko control karta hai.

Storage Proteins germinating seedlings (ugte hue chhote paudon) ki growth ya jaanwaron ki early development (shuru ki nashonuma) ke liye zaroori nutrients (ghizai ajza) jama rakhte hain. Ferritin aik storage protein hai jo kuch bacteria aur paudon aur jaanwaron ke tissues mein milta hai aur iron (loha) jama karta hai.

Structural Proteins vertebrates (reerh ki haddi wale jaandaron) ke jism mein sab se zyada paye jane wale proteins hain. Yeh fibrous ya dhaage jaise hote hain aur jism ki shakal qaim rakhte aur structural support (sahara) dete hain, jaise baalon mein keratin, blood clots (khoon ke lothron) mein fibrin, aur collagen. Yeh jild, ligaments, tendons aur haddiyon ka matrix (buniyadi dhaancha) bhi banate hain.
Contractile Proteins, jaise actin aur myosin, muscle ke patle aur mote filaments (dhaage) banate hain jo muscle fibre ke contraction (sukarna) aur relaxation (dheela hona) mein kaam aate hain.

Defensive proteins jism ko infection se larne aur nuqsan se bachne mein madad dete hain. Maslan antibodies khaas antigens (pathogens, yani jaraseem, par maujood proteins) ko pehchan kar un se mazbooti se jur jati hain aur unhein foran khatam kar deti hain.

Transport ya Carrier Proteins molecules aur ions ko cell membranes ke aar paar le jane mein madad dete hain. Maslan jab khoon lungs (phephron) aur tissues ke darmiyan safar karta hai to haemoglobin molecule ke andar iron atom oxygen se jurta hai.
Receptor Proteins cell ki membrane mein hote hain; yeh cells ke liye chemical signals wasool karte aur jawab aage pohanchate hain.
Regulatory Proteins cell aur jism ki activities (sargarmiyon) ko control karne mein hissa lete hain, jaise insulin, jo sugar ka metabolism control karta hai, aur growth hormone.

blocks.prompt: a) Keratin baal, nakhun, seeng, khur, oon, par, daanton ke enamel aur jild ki bairooni teh mein milne wala structural protein hai jo mazbooti aur lachak deta hai aur aasani se denature nahi hota. Is ki wajah kaun sa bond hai: hydrogen bond ya disulphide bond? Samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Disulphide bonds: yeh chains ke darmiyan covalent S–S jor hain jo hydrogen bonds se kaheen zyada mazboot hain, is liye garmi aur halke chemicals unhein aasani se nahi tor sakte.

blocks.prompt: b) Aik jaisi qism aur tadaad ke amino acids wale do peptides apni primary structure mein kaise mukhtalif ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Wahi amino acids mukhtalif sequence (tarteeb) mein jur sakte hain; sequence badalne se primary structure badal jati hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Hamare jism mein secondary protein structure ki do sab se aam qismein kaun si hain?
d) Denature hua protein theek kaam kyun nahi karta?
blocks.explanation: Denaturing secondary aur tertiary structure ko thaamne wale bonds tor deti hai, is liye protein apni khaas 3D shakal (enzyme mein active site ki shakal) kho deta hai, aur us ka kaam isi shakal par depend karta hai.

blocks.prompt: e) Garam karne par anday ki safedi kyun jam jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Garmi globular protein ki chains ko mura hua rakhne wale hydrogen bonds tor deti hai; chains khul kar aapas mein ulajh jati aur jur jati hain, aur aik insoluble (na ghulne wala) solid ban jata hai (denaturing).

items: Hormonal (insulin), storage (ferritin), structural (keratin, fibrin, collagen), contractile (actin, myosin), defensive (antibodies), transport (haemoglobin), receptor aur regulatory proteins.
